summary: Single-repo bug fix in super_len for StringIO UTF-8 byte length; architect added per reviewer to write HLD constraining the change site before Dev.

steps.why: Single-repo behavioral fix with clear acceptance criteria stated in the ticket.
steps.instructions: Update requirements.md and stories/01-demo-test.md so the change site is super_len only in src/requests/utils.py. Add AC: StringIO('héllo') prepares with Content-Length 6, BytesIO('héllo'.encode()) stays 6. Do not change prepare_body in src/requests/models.py.

steps.why: Reviewer feedback: fix location is a design decision; HLD must constrain the change to super_len only.
steps.instructions: Write HLD constraining the fix to super_len in src/requests/utils.py. When the stream is io.TextIOBase (including StringIO), Content-Length must be UTF-8 byte length, not character count. Do not change prepare_body in src/requests/models.py. Binary BytesIO keeps current byte length. Explicit Content-Length from caller must not be overwritten. Multipart and JSON bodies stay unchanged.

steps.why: Pack per-ticket specs into merged_plan.md for review.
Human approval of specs and this plan before Dev.

skipped.why: Scope is clear and technical; no product sign-off needed for a bug fix.
Work does not split into multiple stories or repos.
HLD provides sufficient implementation constraint; no separate file plan needed.
AC already maps 1:1 to test cases; no additional test design required.
Two documents (requirements, HLD) both trace to the same ticket; consistency is implicit.

feedback.body:
The plan skips the architect, but the fix location is a design decision. Add the architect role and write an HLD before Dev.

Design constraint: change only super_len in src/requests/utils.py. When the stream is a text file object (io.TextIOBase, including StringIO), Content-Length must be the UTF-8 byte length, not the character count. Do not change prepare_body in src/requests/models.py.

Binary BytesIO must keep its current byte length. An explicit Content-Length from the caller must not be overwritten. Multipart and JSON bodies stay unchanged.

Update requirements.md and stories/01-demo-test.md so the change site is super_len only, and add an acceptance criterion: StringIO("héllo") prepares with Content-Length 6, while BytesIO("héllo".encode()) stays Content-Length 6.
feedback.author: pavithrachandran70

change_summary: Added architect role to write HLD constraining the fix to super_len only; analyst reruns to update requirements and story with the design constraint.

addressed.change: Added architect role to produce HLD; analyst reruns with instructions to update requirements.md and stories/01-demo-test.md so change site is super_len only, and add AC for StringIO('héllo') and BytesIO('héllo'.encode()).
